title: Towards Superior Cross-Domain Adaptability in Embodied AI: A Multimodal Adaptive Fusion Mechanism with Meta-Learning

contributions.mechanism: 多模态自适应融合+环境特定权重(softmax)+MAML元学习一致性对比损失
contributions.source_quote: our method combines environment-specific weight adjustment with meta-learning-based validation, differentiating by enabling real-time modality importance changes based on context

contributions.purpose: 实证跨域适应性优于基线
contributions.mechanism: AI2-THOR/RoboSuite上与单模态RL/静态融合/无融合元学习对比+消融
contributions.evaluation: 目标域SR最高88.4%、泛化差最低4.4%、适配效率2-3x;但代码/数据以"商业IP"为由不公开
contributions.source_quote: Experiments on AI2-THOR and RoboSuite benchmarks show significant improvements in success rates (up to 88.4% in target domains), reduced generalization gaps (down to 4.4%), and faster adaptation (2-3x efficiency over baselines).

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike prior static fusion or single-modality meta-learning approaches [13], our method combines environment-specific weight adjustment with meta-learning-based validation

Our consistency loss (Lcons) directly reinforces policy consistency during cross-domain transfers, unlike meta-controllers (54) or unsupervised meta-skills (55), which lack explicit multimodal fusion.
